notes: ROUTE: reached directly with curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131, no WAF block, exactly as the prior Home-Decor pass recorded. robots.txt (dated 2025-07-25) names no Claude/Anthropic/ClaudeBot agent. The roster URL https://www.johnlewis.com/browse/home-garden/_/N-5xtqo is still dead (404); the live furniture department is Furniture & Lights at /furniture-lights/c9780211221. TREE: taken from the Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ props.pageProps.category nav tree on the department page and on every hub listed in category.xml (sofas-armchairs c600003674, living-room c60000554, home-office c60000737, bedroom c6000074, childrens c60000658, kitchen c60000557, dining-room c60000144, garden c600002138), plus home-storage c60000256, bathroom-accessories c700002085 and baby-child nursery c6000062 for furniture filed outside the department. Cross-checked against the full grids sitemap (192 gzipped files, 1180 non-facet /browse/.../_/N-* category URLs extracted); the only furniture-shaped nodes it added beyond the nav were the 'ranges' pages, which were dropped. COUNTS: for every Endeca /browse/ leaf the qty is the rendered listing header "You've viewed N of TOTAL items" read out of the served HTML; it matched __NEXT_DATA__:props.pageProps.productListingData.results on every leaf. Six leaves were read twice (Bed Frames, Dining Chairs, Side Tables, Wardrobes, Garden Furniture Sets, Hallway) and were identical on both reads. VERIFICATION: pagination to exhaustion of the five garden nodes reached exactly their reported totals (148, 76, 34, 24 and 47 unique productIds). The site A/B-tests page size (48 vs 72), so a mixed-size walk can skip items; unique-ID exhaustion, not ceil(total/pageSize), was used. SOFAS: John Lewis has migrated the whole sofa/armchair department off Endeca onto a client-rendered range-browser at /furniture-lights/sofas/<type>; every legacy Endeca URL (N-7hh2, N-7hfw, N-7hfs, N-7hfu, N-7hfv, N-7l3j) 301s to it. That surface publishes only an 'N ranges' header and no product total, so the seven sofa rows carry the ranges number as qty with a MANUAL REVIEW flag that also records the product total printed on the range cards. Its Type filter (Sofas / Armchairs / Snugglers / Corner sofas / Sofa beds / Chaise longues / Footstools) was used as the taxonomy; Accent Chairs (28 ranges) was dropped because the page's own displayFilters shows it selected under Style, not Type, i.e. a subset of Armchairs. Range productCounts are filter-aware (Munro: 8 as a sofa, 2 as an armchair, 11 unfiltered), but the type pages still overlap - 1183 products across the seven types against 1053 on the unfiltered root. OVERLAP CHECKS: Balcony Furniture (24) was dropped - full enumeration puts 22 of its 24 productIds inside Garden Furniture Sets / Garden Seating / Garden Tables, so it is a shop-by-space re-cut. Conservatory Furniture (47) shares only 4 ids with the other garden nodes and was kept. Garden Furniture Sets x Garden Seating = 4 and x Garden Tables = 9, so all three were kept. Design Your Own Dining Tables (16) was dropped: 15 of its 16 ids are inside Dining Tables. EXCLUSIONS: mattresses and cot/moses-basket mattress nodes (bedding, not furniture); all lighting and lampshades (Lighting task); bathroom mirrors, pictures and wall stickers (Wall Decor); rugs, cushions, bedding, curtains and bean bags (textiles); Toy Boxes and Storage (40 - Product Type is Storage Boxes 11 / Storage Cabinet 11 / Box 6 / Basket 5, i.e. standalone storage) and Nursery Storage (31 - boxes and baskets); the home-storage facet cuts (storage boxes, storage baskets, laundry baskets, hangers, clothes rails, shoe racks, coat stands); Baby Pods and Nests; kitchen sinks, taps, wine racks, ladders and food-waste disposers; garden buildings, sheds, summerhouses and outdoor storage; parasols, garden furniture covers, outdoor cushions, BBQs, pizza ovens, firepits, hot tubs, saunas and gardening tools; upholstery and fabric swatches. Dropped under the never-extract rule as collections/ranges/landing pages: Garden Furniture Ranges (19), Kids Bedroom Ranges (30), Dining Room Furniture Ranges (14), Editions kitchen cabinets (10) and Elements kitchen cabinets (6), New in furniture, New in garden, the design-style edits and every brand page. Sun loungers and the bookcase / shelving-unit / shelves splits were dropped as producttype facet cuts (N-...Z...) of nodes already recorded. The un-navigated roll-up /browse/baby-child/nursery-furniture-furnishings/nursery-furniture/_/N-ntgv (105) was dropped as a mixed re-cut: 31 of its items are mattresses and it overlaps the specific nursery nodes recorded here.
